rollback_evidence: G144 J29. One IPv4 pool network (access address-assignment pool, family inet network); a pool with other statements (ranges, DHCP attributes) is left untouched and a pool with host reservations cannot be deleted. The Junos commit confirmed safeguard protects the change and the inverse restores the exact configured attributes (G144). The write account reads the object back from the scoped configuration; the read-only account cannot read the configuration and no operational view lists an address-assignment pool or a relay group.
